hunks.baseline: A tremendous roar and vibrations transmitted through the ground.
hunks.sol: A tremendous roar shook the air, while vibrations traveled through the ground.

hunks.baseline: The twenty-year-old man staring toward the horizon, Shao Shen, could not believe what was happening.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen stared toward the horizon, unable to believe what was happening.

hunks.baseline: *They’re supposed to be thousands of kilometers away. How are the monsters…?*
hunks.sol: *The monsters are supposed to be thousands of kilometers away. How did they…?*

hunks.baseline: This was not a question Shao Shen alone had asked himself.
hunks.sol: The twenty-year-old was not the only one wondering.

hunks.baseline: More than a thousand Hunters from the Public Security Armed Forces Department and five thousand members of the Chinese People’s Liberation Army dispatched to maintain public order were stationed at Chengdu International Airport. Every one of them had wondered the same thing, and all of them were stunned by the reality bearing down on them.
hunks.sol: More than a thousand Hunters from the Public Security Armed Forces Department and five thousand members of the Chinese People’s Liberation Army had been dispatched to Chengdu International Airport to maintain public order. Every one of them had the same question, and every one of them was stunned by the reality bearing down on them.

hunks.baseline: As the distance of one kilometer rapidly closed by the second, cries like screams broke out.
hunks.sol: The one-kilometer gap was closing by the second. Panicked cries rang out.

hunks.baseline: “Form up by platoon! Assemble! Assemble—!”
hunks.sol: “Form ranks by unit! Assemble! Form up—!”

hunks.baseline: “Fire! Fire!”
hunks.sol: “Fire! Fire, damn it!”

hunks.baseline: The People’s Liberation Army hurriedly formed ranks and unleashed their firepower at their commanders’ orders, but the effect was utterly negligible.
hunks.sol: The People’s Liberation Army hurriedly formed ranks and unleashed their firepower at their commanders’ orders, but the effect was negligible.

hunks.baseline: An unexpected army of monsters had attacked.
hunks.sol: No one had expected an army of monsters to attack.

hunks.baseline: The soldiers, ordinary people without any abilities, were paralyzed with fear. The weapons they fired were effective only against low-level monsters at best.
hunks.sol: The soldiers were ordinary people without any special abilities. Fear paralyzed them, and their weapons were effective only against low-level monsters at best.

hunks.baseline: “There are too many monsters! There are too many!”
hunks.sol: “There are too many! There are too many monsters!”

hunks.baseline: “Get the fighter jets into the air! Bomb them from above—!”
hunks.sol: “Get the fighter jets in the air! Bomb them from above—!”

hunks.baseline: The frantic shouts of the commanders were drowned out the next moment by a vicious roar that echoed through the sky.
hunks.sol: The commanders’ frantic shouts were drowned out by a ferocious roar from the sky.

hunks.baseline: A gigantic body flew in with the setting sun behind it.
hunks.sol: A gigantic shape flew toward them with the setting sun at its back.

hunks.baseline: A Wyvern, known as the terror of the skies, led the way, followed by dozens of Griffons and Gargoyles.
hunks.sol: A Wyvern, known as the terror of the skies, led the charge, followed by dozens of Griffons and Gargoyles.

hunks.baseline: The A-rank monsters angled their several-meter-long wings and dove upon the fighter jets that had not yet managed to take off.
hunks.sol: The A-rank monsters angled their wings, each several meters long, and dove upon the fighter jets that had yet to take off.

hunks.baseline: The tons of metal lurched beneath their powerful wingbeats, while the aircraft hulls were torn apart like sheets of paper by claws imbued with mana.
hunks.sol: Their powerful wingbeats rocked the several-ton machines, while mana-infused claws tore through the aircraft hulls like paper.

hunks.baseline: Metal fragments blasted away with tremendous force alongside the explosions, crashing into the pilots who were running frantically toward their planes.
hunks.sol: Metal fragments blasted outward with tremendous force, mowing down the pilots running frantically toward their planes.

hunks.baseline: They died instantly, without even leaving behind a scream.
hunks.sol: They died instantly, without even the chance to scream.

hunks.baseline: The firearms roared at the commanders’ orders once they regained their senses, but the monsters’ skin and hides, saturated with powerful mana, could do no more than suffer scratches beneath hundreds or thousands of bullets.
hunks.sol: The commanders regained their senses and ordered the soldiers to open fire, but even hundreds—thousands—of bullets left no more than scratches on the monsters’ mana-infused skin and hides.
The monsters laughed at the helpless humans.

hunks.baseline: At the monsters’ laughter mocking the helpless humans, everyone felt a shock of terror that made the hair on their entire bodies stand on end.
hunks.sol: A shock of terror swept through the soldiers, making every hair on their bodies stand on end.

hunks.baseline: An army of monsters filled both the ground and the sky. The creatures were monsters in every sense of the word, and even firearms barely affected them.
hunks.sol: An army of monsters filled the ground and sky. Even firearms barely affected them.
They were monsters in every sense of the word.

hunks.baseline: “I-I have to live. I don’t want to die like a dog in a place like this!”
hunks.sol: “I-I have to get out of here. I don’t want to die like a dog in a place like this!”

hunks.baseline: And while the members of the People’s Liberation Army were slowly backing away, one person was instead advancing toward the front.
hunks.sol: As the People’s Liberation Army began backing away, one person strode forward instead.

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen, a young man who had not yet lost all traces of his youth, shouted with blazing eyes.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen shouted, his youthful face still not quite rid of its boyishness and his eyes blazing.

hunks.baseline: The Five-Starred Red Flag, the national flag of the People’s Republic of China, was embroidered across the chest of his armor.
hunks.sol: The Five-Starred Red Flag, the national flag of the People’s Republic of China, was emblazoned across the chest of his armor.

hunks.baseline: At the young man’s question, those who had been trying to flee stopped in their tracks.
hunks.sol: Those who had been about to flee stopped in their tracks at the young man’s question.

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen glared at the army of monsters charging from several hundred meters away. His voice thundered out once more from beneath his tightly pulled-down helmet.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen glared at the army of monsters charging from several hundred meters away. His voice thundered once more from beneath his low-pulled helmet.

hunks.baseline: His shout made their blood boil.
hunks.sol: The shout made their blood boil.

hunks.baseline: With every eye upon him, Shao Shen raised the tip of his spear.
hunks.sol: With every eye upon him, Shao Shen raised his spearhead high.

hunks.baseline: “We are the descendants of Zhonghua, and we are brothers in the People’s Liberation Army and the Public Security Armed Forces Department!”
hunks.sol: “We are the descendants of Zhonghua! We are brothers of the People’s Liberation Army and the Public Security Armed Forces Department!”

hunks.baseline: An aura resembling the light of the setting sun rose from the spearhead, which had been thrust high enough to pierce the heavens.
hunks.sol: Aura the color of sunset blazed from the spearhead thrust toward the heavens.

hunks.baseline: A tremendous roar that numbed the ears shook the earth.
hunks.sol: A tremendous roar numbed the ears and shook the earth.

hunks.baseline: Led by Shao Shen, the Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces Department gripped their weapons and charged toward the army of monsters like ravenous tigers.
hunks.sol: Led by Shao Shen, the Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces Department gripped their weapons and charged the monster army like ferocious tigers.

hunks.baseline: Human cries filled with the resolve to face death mingled with the monsters’ shrieks. The two groups collided and became entangled in one mass.
hunks.sol: Human shouts filled with the resolve to die mingled with the monsters’ shrieks. The two forces crashed together and became entangled in a single mass.

hunks.baseline: A clash that shook the sky and earth. Death rained down from every direction.
hunks.sol: The collision shook heaven and earth. Death rained down from every direction.

hunks.baseline: Squish! Crack!
hunks.sol: Thud! Crack!

hunks.baseline: Screams and thunderous noises rang out from every part of the battlefield.
hunks.sol: Screams and thunderous impacts rang out across the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: An A-rank Hunter’s aura-coated blade sliced through a Lycanthrope’s neck, while the iron club swung by an ogre turned three or four Hunters into bloody pulp and sent them flying.
hunks.sol: An A-rank Hunter’s aura-coated blade sliced through a Lycanthrope’s neck, while a single swing of an ogre’s iron club reduced three or four Hunters to bloody pulp and sent them flying.

hunks.baseline: Two Hunters combined their strength to bring down a monster, then raised their weapons toward the next enemy. A gigantic shadow fell over their heads.
hunks.sol: Two Hunters combined their strength to bring down a monster. As they raised their weapons against their next foe, a gigantic shadow fell over them.

hunks.baseline: The claws of a Griffon diving straight down tore the Hunters’ bodies apart along with their armor.
hunks.sol: A Griffon plunged from the sky, its claws shredding the Hunters’ bodies along with their armor.

hunks.baseline: A large ball of fire flew toward the Griffon as it searched for its next prey.
hunks.sol: As it searched for its next prey, a large ball of fire hurtled toward it.

hunks.baseline: The Griffon’s body, gliding through the sky, lurched amid the acrid smoke. The ranged units on the ground, waiting for the perfect opportunity, did not let the opening pass.
hunks.sol: The Griffon’s body reeled amid the acrid smoke. The ranged units on the ground had been watching for just such an opportunity, and they did not let it pass.

hunks.baseline: All manner of spells and arrows brimming with mana pierced the Griffon.
hunks.sol: Spells of every color and arrows brimming with mana pierced the Griffon.

hunks.baseline: As the Griffon plummeted with a dying shriek, the flying monsters let loose ferocious cries.
hunks.sol: It plummeted with a dying shriek, and the other flying monsters let loose ferocious cries.

hunks.baseline: Modern weapons made of lead and iron blocked the flying monsters as they plunged toward the ranged units.
hunks.sol: They dove toward the ranged units, only to be met by modern weapons of lead and steel.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “Concentrated fire, commence!”
hunks.sol: “Concentrated fire!”

hunks.baseline: Countless rifles and heavy weapons, along with dozens of tanks, belched fire all at once.
hunks.sol: Countless rifles and heavy weapons opened fire. Dozens of tanks unleashed their cannons at once.

hunks.baseline: Though modern weapons could not compare to mana—the natural counter to the monsters’ magical power—concentrating their firepower all at once forced even the flying monsters to hesitate.
hunks.sol: Modern weapons could not compare to mana, the natural counter to a monster’s magical power, but so much concentrated fire still forced the flying monsters to falter.

hunks.baseline: “It works!”
hunks.sol: “It’s working!”

hunks.baseline: “It’s useless anywhere else! Aim for their eyes!”
hunks.sol: “Anywhere else is useless! Aim for their eyes!”

hunks.baseline: The flesh of monsters, which had been saturated with mana since birth, easily ignored most physical force. But there was one exception: their eyes.
hunks.sol: The flesh of monsters, saturated with mana from birth, easily shrugged off most physical force.
But there was one exception: the eyes.

hunks.baseline: Their eyeballs, covered by a thin membrane, could be damaged sufficiently if heavy weapons were brought to bear.
hunks.sol: Covered only by a thin membrane, their eyeballs could be damaged by heavy weapons.

hunks.baseline: At the sight of the monsters hesitating, the divisional commander, who had been watching the entire scene, excitedly waved his command baton.
hunks.sol: At the sight of the monsters hesitating, the divisional commander who had been watching the battle excitedly waved his command baton.

hunks.baseline: “More! Pour it on! Don’t let those monsters move—”
hunks.sol: “More! Pour it on! Pin those monsters down—”

hunks.baseline: His voice never continued.
hunks.sol: His voice cut off.

hunks.baseline: The Poison Breath fired by a Green Wyvern blanketed an area over a hundred meters in radius, and the divisional commander and his command staff were drenched in the powerful acidic poison and melted away.
hunks.sol: Poison Breath from a Green Wyvern blanketed an area over a hundred meters in radius. The divisional commander and his command staff were drenched in powerful acidic poison and melted away.

hunks.baseline: The People’s Liberation Army lost hundreds of soldiers and high-ranking officers in the blink of an eye and fell into a state of panic.
hunks.sol: The People’s Liberation Army lost hundreds of soldiers and high-ranking officers in the blink of an eye. Panic swept through its ranks.

hunks.baseline: Officers, noncommissioned officers, and soldiers alike stared at the horrific scene unfolding before their eyes, crying out in shock.
hunks.sol: Officers, noncommissioned officers, and enlisted soldiers alike stared at the horrific scene before them, crying out in shock.

hunks.baseline: Someone’s scream spoke for everyone’s feelings.
hunks.sol: That scream spoke for all of them.

hunks.baseline: They had brought their forces in preparation for an emergency, but their primary mission was to join and escort the foreign Hunters who would soon arrive at Chengdu International Airport, then act according to their superiors’ orders.
hunks.sol: They had deployed in force as a precaution, but their primary mission was to meet and escort the foreign Hunters arriving at Chengdu International Airport, then follow their superiors’ orders.

hunks.baseline: They had never heard a single word about an army of monsters that was supposed to be thousands of kilometers away invading them.
hunks.sol: No one had said anything about an army of monsters thousands of kilometers away invading the airport.

hunks.baseline: “What the hell is this…?”
hunks.sol: “What the hell is happening…?”

hunks.baseline: The fear they had briefly forgotten settled over the heads of the People’s Liberation Army.
hunks.sol: The fear they had briefly forgotten descended upon the People’s Liberation Army once more.

hunks.baseline: They were not the Hunters from the Public Security Armed Forces Department fighting at the front of the battlefield. They were nothing more than ordinary people carrying modern firearms.
hunks.sol: They were not the Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces Department fighting at the front. They were only ordinary people carrying modern firearms.

hunks.baseline: And their ominous suspicion soon became reality.
hunks.sol: Their grim premonition soon became reality.

hunks.baseline: A voice broken into disconnected syllables. An eerie noise resembling the static of a radio with an unstable signal echoed across the battlefield.
hunks.sol: A voice spoke in broken, disconnected syllables. The eerie sound, like static from a radio with a poor signal, echoed across the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: Black fog that had gathered from somewhere spread over the people’s heads.
hunks.sol: Black fog rolled in from nowhere and spread over their heads.

hunks.baseline: That was when the horrific change occurred.
hunks.sol: That was when the horrific change began.

hunks.baseline: Swoosh!
hunks.sol: Swoooosh!

hunks.baseline: Dark mana, black as storm clouds, spread like a web through the blood and corpses.
hunks.sol: Dark mana, black as storm clouds, spread through the blood and corpses like a spiderweb.

hunks.baseline: It breathed new power and souls into the corpses growing cold, binding them in chains and subjugating them.
hunks.sol: It breathed new power and souls into the bodies growing cold, binding and subjugating them with chains.

hunks.baseline: Thud. Thud-thud-thud.
hunks.sol: Crack. Crack-crack-crack.

hunks.baseline: An army of skeletons gained new life and slowly rose from pools of death.
hunks.sol: An army of skeletons slowly rose from pools of death, granted new life.

hunks.baseline: *Those beings* had woven countless dead together with invisible chains and made them their slaves. They laughed with satisfaction.
hunks.sol: *Those beings* bound the countless dead with invisible chains and made them their slaves.
They laughed in satisfaction.

hunks.baseline: With a bubbling sound, a man rose to his feet.
hunks.sol: A bubbling growl rose from the man’s throat as he climbed to his feet.

hunks.baseline: He wore armor emblazoned with the Five-Starred Red Flag and carried a massive ax. He looked exactly like the A-rank Hunter Shao Shen remembered.
hunks.sol: Clad in armor emblazoned with the Five-Starred Red Flag and carrying a massive ax, he looked exactly like the A-rank Hunter Shao Shen remembered.

hunks.baseline: But Shao Shen could not call the man’s name aloud. He could not bring himself to.
hunks.sol: But Shao Shen could not say the man’s name aloud.
He could not bring himself to.

hunks.baseline: Because he knew that the person standing before him was no longer the man he had known.
hunks.sol: The man before him was no longer the person he had known.

hunks.baseline: If he had not witnessed the man’s head being severed only ten minutes earlier—if he had not seen him rise at this very moment with his own severed head tucked beneath his arm—Shao Shen would have thought of him as a colleague and friend.
hunks.sol: If Shao Shen had not witnessed his decapitation a little over ten minutes earlier—if the man had not risen with his own severed head tucked under one arm—he would still have thought of him as a colleague and friend.

hunks.baseline: A new name slipped between Shao Shen’s lips.
hunks.sol: His new name slipped from Shao Shen’s lips.

hunks.baseline: A headless knight. A Dullahan.
hunks.sol: A headless knight.

hunks.sol: A Dullahan.
The Dullahan charged with a shriek.

hunks.baseline: As the Dullahan charged with a shriek, Shao Shen shot forward like the wind.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen shot forward like the wind.

hunks.baseline: In the past, the two of them had often sparred like this. What began as simple competitive pride continued every day, and whenever the sparring ended, Shao Shen had to put up with Yao Wei’s complaints.
hunks.sol: The two of them had often sparred like this. What began as simple competitive pride became a daily routine, and after every bout, Shao Shen had to endure Yao Wei’s complaints.

hunks.baseline: *You little punk, where are your manners? Would it kill you to let me win once?*
hunks.sol: *You little punk. Where are your manners? Would it kill you to let me win once?*

hunks.baseline: *Ha-ha. Let’s go get something to eat. The loser was supposed to pay, so I guess you’re buying again today, Mr. Yao Wei.*
hunks.sol: *Ha-ha. Let’s go get something to eat. The loser pays, so I guess you’re buying again today, Mr. Yao Wei.*

hunks.baseline: *You’ve got plenty of money at home, and you’re still so greedy. One day, I’ll make you buy me a meal.*
hunks.sol: *You’re from a rich family, yet you’re still such a penny-pincher. One of these days, I’m going to make you buy me a meal.*

hunks.baseline: But that had never happened before, and it never would.
hunks.sol: But that had never happened, and now it never would.

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen had always been the winner.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen had always won.

hunks.baseline: The ax swung through empty air, while the aura surging from Shao Shen’s spearhead cleaved through the Dullahan’s upper body.
hunks.sol: The ax cleaved through empty air.

hunks.baseline: A line was drawn from the waist upward. The headless knight’s body slowly collapsed.
hunks.sol: Aura blazed from Shao Shen’s spearhead and tore through the Dullahan’s torso from the waist. The headless knight slowly crumpled.

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen stared blankly down at the face of the fallen Dullahan—or rather, Yao Wei—and his eyes burned.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen stared down at the face of the fallen Dullahan—no, Yao Wei—and his eyes burned.

hunks.baseline: “How dare you… How dare you do this…”
hunks.sol: “How dare you… How dare you do this…?”

hunks.baseline: Only half a day ago, his friends and colleagues had been laughing and chatting alongside him. Now they had become undead monsters.
hunks.sol: Only half a day ago, these friends and colleagues had been laughing and talking with him.

hunks.sol: Now they were undead monsters.

hunks.baseline: The Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces Department were famous for their strict discipline, but they were not cold-blooded people without a drop of blood in their veins.
hunks.sol: The Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces Department were renowned for their strict discipline, but they were not cold-blooded machines.

hunks.baseline: The Hunters who had entered battle prepared to die now faced a new kind of fear for the first time: their attachment to one another.
hunks.sol: They had entered battle prepared to die. Now, for the first time, they faced the fear born of their attachment to one another.

hunks.baseline: “Hyung…!”
hunks.sol: “H-Hyung…!”
Screams and death rained down from every direction.

hunks.baseline: Screams and death rained down from every direction. Unlike the Public Security Armed Forces Department, which had suffered losses approaching half its strength, the army of monsters had actually increased its numbers and continued pouring forward without end.
hunks.sol: The Public Security Armed Forces Department had lost nearly half its strength. The monster army, on the other hand, had only grown in number and continued pouring forward without end.
For the first time in his life, Shao Shen contemplated his own death.

hunks.baseline: For the first time in his life, Shao Shen thought of death. The situation was desperate enough to make even someone as bright and cheerful as him think that way.
hunks.sol: The situation was desperate enough to make even someone as bright and cheerful as him think that way.

hunks.baseline: *We never received a warning signal, so communications are probably down. There won’t be any reinforcements either… This really is the end.*
hunks.sol: *We never received a warning signal, so communications must be down. There won’t be any reinforcements either… This really is the end.*

hunks.baseline: After cutting down one undead monster after another as they charged him, Shao Shen laughed hollowly and looked up at the sky.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen cut down one charging undead monster after another, then laughed hollowly and looked up at the sky.
The sunset was beautiful.

hunks.baseline: The sunset was quite beautiful. Once the sun went down and darkness arrived, he would never see a sight like this again.
hunks.sol: Once the sun went down and darkness came, he would never see a sight like it again.

hunks.baseline: *At least the last sky I see is pretty decent…*
hunks.sol: *At least the last sky I see isn’t half bad…*

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen blinked, unable to continue his thought.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen blinked, his thought cut short.

hunks.baseline: Something enormous was approaching the battlefield at tremendous speed high above.
hunks.sol: Something enormous was hurtling toward the battlefield from high above.
A gigantic aircraft wreathed in flames.

hunks.baseline: A gigantic aircraft wreathed in flames. And someone’s shout echoing across the vast sky.
hunks.sol: Then someone’s shout rang across the vast sky.

hunks.baseline: Everyone on the battlefield, not only Shao Shen, looked up at the sky.
hunks.sol: Not only Shao Shen but everyone on the battlefield looked up.

hunks.baseline: Someone’s voice, carrying an almost palpable madness, rang out like thunder.
hunks.sol: A voice filled with palpable madness boomed like thunder.

hunks.baseline: “I’m going to ram it!”
hunks.sol: “I’m putting it in!”

hunks.baseline: Ram what?
hunks.sol: Putting what in?

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen soon understood what those words meant.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen soon understood.

hunks.sol: The airplane’s enormous fuselage plowed straight across the battlefield.
